messages.content: Translate the complete CURRENT legal source into a FEW executable semantic constructor expressions. Output operative disclosure permissions/prohibitions and any definitions needed to interpret them. Do not reproduce the source as text records. Expressions use the acquired constructor names as functions with positional arguments; nest calls directly. A zero-argument constructor is NAME(). Text arguments use ordinary ASCII quote delimiters and describe only source-supported names or qualifications. Prefer short exact source wording; canonical descriptions must preserve its exact meaning. Never import an old example participant, purpose or condition. Each statement cites all current span IDs supporting that coherent interpretation. A definition may be a separate statement used by a referring norm. No native answer labels, raw-text roots, Python variables, assignments or imports. There is no literal operator and no model-written node numbering. If no supported interpretation is available, return statements:[]; unknown must not become a negative fact. Distinguish information descriptions, permissions, restrictions, the acting party, recipient ownership, definition references and exception scope. Preserve nested ownership and locally bound references in the tree. Do not infer a permission from a role mention or copy every operator into the output. Use only supported operators; leave unresolved interpretations absent rather than inventing facts. The examples/productions describe a learned translation language: {ARG0:Type} in a source_pattern and ARG0,ARG1 in templates denote typed grammar slots. In your final expressions replace them with actual constructor expressions or current-source strings. Old example facts are not current facts.

"}, {"id": 16, "field": "source_text", "start": 2840, "end": 3326, "text": "Where any Confidential Information is derived from the synthesis in a unique manner, or into a unique concept, of various elements that may be contained in the public domain, no part of the Confidential Information shall be deemed to be in the public domain or to be in the Receiving Party’s possession or to be thereafter acquired by the Receiving Party merely because it embraces information in the public domain or general information that the Receiving Party may thereafter acquire."}, {"id": 17, "field": "source_text", "start": 3328, "end": 3408, "text": "(b) “Disclosing Party” shall mean the Party disclosing Confidential Information."}, {"id": 18, "field": "source_text", "start": 3410, "end": 3506, "text": "(c) “Receiving Party” Shall mean the Party receiving disclosure of the Confidential Information."}, {"id": 19, "field": "source_text", "start": 3508, "end": 3724, "text": "(d) It is specifically understood and agreed that Confidential Information shall include the existence of this Agreement and its terms and the fact that the Parties are discussing and evaluating the Business Purpose."}, {"id": 20, "field": "source_text", "start": 3726, "end": 3744, "text": "2. Applicability. "}, {"id": 21, "field": "source_text", "start": 3744, "end": 4271, "text": "This Agreement shall apply to all Confidential Information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, and Confidential Information shall include extracts, analyses, compilations, studies or other documents or records prepared by or for the Receiving Party or any of Receiving Party’s Representatives (defined in Paragraph 4) to the extent that such extracts, analyses, compilations, studies, documents or records contain or otherwise reflect or are generated from the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information."}, {"id": 22, "field": "source_text", "start": 4273, "end": 4291, "text": "3. "}, {"id": 24, "field": "source_text", "start": 4303, "end": 4321, "text": "Each Party agrees:"}, {"id": 25, "field": "source_text", "start": 4323, "end": 4433, "text": "(a) to hold the other Party’s Confidential Information in strict confidence in accordance with this Agreement;"}, {"id": 26, "field": "source_text", "start": 4435, "end": 4657, "text": "(b) to exercise at least the same care in protecting the other Party’s Confidential Information from disclosure as the Party uses with regard to its own Confidential Information (but in no event less than reasonable care);"}, {"id": 27, "field": "source_text", "start": 4659, "end": 4935, "text": "(c) not to disclose such Confidential Information to third parties (including, without limitation, any clients, affiliates, independent contractors and consultants) without the prior, written consent of the Disclosing Party except as expressly permitted under Paragraph 4; and"}, {"id": 28, "field": "source_text", "start": 4937, "end": 5087, "text": "(d) not to use any Confidential Information for any purpose except for the Business Purpose without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party."}, {"id": 29, "field": "source_text", "start": 5089, "end": 5172, "text": "4. "}, {"id": 31, "field": "source_text", "start": 5599, "end": 5654, "text": "Each Party agrees to instruct all such Representatives "}, {"id": 32, "field": "source_text", "start": 5654, "end": 5728, "text": "(i) of the identities of the Party’s other permitted Representatives, and "}, {"id": 33, "field": "source_text", "start": 5728, "end": 6017, "text": "(ii) not to disclose such Confidential Information to any third parties (including, without limitation, any clients, affiliates, subsidiaries, independent contractors, and consultants) other than the identified Representatives without the prior written permission of the Disclosing Party.
